title: Pin files
key_points: Learn how to pin files in IPFS to keep them local.
There are three kinds of pins: local, remote, and recursive.
Local pinning keeps the file on your own node's filesystem.
limitations: The guide assumes basic familiarity with IPFS concepts and setup.
asserts: Pinning files in IPFS allows you to keep them locally available for faster access.
scope: Describes how to pin files using IPFS, a distributed file system protocol.
